description: Non-binding indicative price range (EUR net) for one dedicated vehicle between two locations in Europe — same formula as the calculator on the operator's website. No booking is made. Location needs country plus city (or German postal code). Returns status: estimated | needs_information (answer the questions and call again) | manual_quote_required | unsupported. Never present the result as a fixed price.

city.description: City name (German or English), e.g. Berlin, Warsaw

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. DE, PL, FR

postal_code.description: 5-digit postal code for DE (used for the estimate); other countries: passed on to the team
